verdict.rationale: Release changelog generation is a fair question for a work-management tool, but the pack documents no first-party capability for it. What it does show is adjacent only: a tutorial for building your own status-update report app, generic MCP 'reports and summaries', and GitHub PR status sync. None of these produces a per-release changelog.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can auto-generate a changelog for each release so shipping progress is easy to review
